`phase_tracker({ action: "start", phase: "ship" })`

**Aliases:** A/B/C are the pre-rework heads of #12/#13/#14 (`aaaaaaa`/`bbbbbbb`/`ccccccc`). E is local HEAD before the seal. S is HEAD after the seal.

**Checkpoint 1: Input and verify**
- `WORKTREE=/work/widget/.worktrees/retry`, `PRIMARY=/work/widget`, `FEATURE=retry`.
- The Rework record has three pairs, home first: #12→A, #13→B, #14→C. `PRE_REWORK_HEAD=A`.
- Combined fields read: Base `main`, Keeps `retry behavior`, Changes `repair retries`, Dropped `none`, Scoped `test-retry`. Lowercase provenance is ignored.
- `gh pr view 12` shows OPEN, head `retry`, base `main`.
- The skip rule holds: test-retry passed on a clean commit, and the tree checks are clean. Evidence captured: test-retry green; HOME task accepted-complete.

**Checkpoint 2: Preflight**
- `git fetch origin` succeeds.
- A, B and C are each ancestors of E (exit 0).
- `origin/retry` is an ancestor of E, so push is offered.
- Selected: **1. Push to the PR branch (PR #12, retry)**.

**Checkpoint 3: Threads (refetched per PR)**
- **#12:** HOME → `fixed in fffffff`
- **#13:** MEMBER13 → recorded `fix` copied (no home first-parent proof). NEW13 → `still open` (newly opened).
- **#14:** MEMBER14 → recorded `keep open`, now resolved on GitHub.

**Checkpoint 4: Strip, seal, refs, push**
- Plan removed.
- `gauntlet-telemetry-seal.mjs --worktree "$WORKTREE" --option pr --base origin/main --spec <spec>` prints `sealed <record>`.
- `update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-12 A`, `pr-13 B`, `pr-14 C`.
- `git -C "$WORKTREE" push --no-follow-tags origin HEAD:refs/heads/retry` succeeds (non-force). Pushed head is S.

**Checkpoint 5: Description**
- `gh pr view 12 --json body` returns the bytes `Original description\n`.
- `SCRATCH=$(mktemp)` outside the repo receives those bytes, a blank line, then:

```markdown

Before: A (local ref `refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-12` in the rework checkout; the SHA is the portable handle and stays on origin because the push was not forced)
Absorbs: #13 (https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/13), #14 (https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/14)
Spec: <spec> at S
Keeps: retry behavior
Changes: repair retries
Dropped claims: none
Verification: scoped - test-retry; CI on this push holds the full run. Telemetry: whole PR against main.

#12:
- src/retry.ts:1 - fixed in fffffff
#13:
- src/delay.ts:2 - fix (recorded)
- <NEW13 location> - still open
#14:
- src/cap.ts:3 - keep open (recorded; newly resolved)
```

- `gh pr edit 12 --repo acme/widget --body-file "$SCRATCH"` succeeds.

**Checkpoint 6: Eligibility**
- #13 is OPEN at B, and B is an ancestor of S.
- #14 is OPEN at C, and C is an ancestor of S.

```text
Close the absorbed PRs with these comments?
#13: "Reworked into #12 (https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/12) by the gauntlet; this PR's commits are merged there and remain reachable as bbbbbbb."
#14: "Reworked into #12 (https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/12) by the gauntlet; this PR's commits are merged there and remain reachable as ccccccc."
```

**Answer 1**
- Recheck shows no change, then `gh pr close 13 --comment "<#13 text>" -R acme/widget` runs.
- Recheck shows no change, then the same runs for #14. Neither uses `--delete-branch`.
- `phase_tracker({ action: "complete", phase: "ship" })` runs only after the closes.
- Report: `Closed: #13, #14`. Worktree preserved. Seal output: `sealed <record>`.

**Independent deltas**

| Variant | Delta |
|---|---|
| Answer 2 | Nothing is closed. Ship is completed after the answer. `Member PRs #13, #14 left open.` |
| #14 head changes after approval | #13 closes. The #14 recheck shows a new head, so it is skipped with no close. Ship completes after that. `Closed: #13; #14 skipped: head changed after approval (head moved to <sha7>, not in home)` |

| #14 close fails once | No retry. Ship completes after the attempt. `Closed: #13; #14 close failed (<error>)` |
| Row 5 (Keep) | No strip, seal, ref write, push, body edit or close question. Reports `Keeping branch retry. Worktree preserved at /work/widget/.worktrees/retry.` The telemetry record stays in_progress. `Member PRs #13, #14 left open.` Ship completes right after the Keep report. |

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
### Row 1 — simulated checkpoint deltas

Aliases: `A`, `B`, `C`, `E` denote the supplied full heads for #12, #13, #14, and initial HEAD. `P` denotes the successfully pushed post-seal head; `SPEC` denotes the selected spec path.

- **Verification:** reuse passing `test-retry` evidence; telemetry-excluding diff and status checks are clean. Retain scoped commands and accepted-complete HOME task evidence before stripping.
- **Preflight:** home is OPEN on `retry`, base `main`. Fetch succeeds; all three original-head ancestry proofs and the `origin/retry` proof pass.
- **Threads:** refresh #12, #13, and #14 independently, including pagination. HOME → `fixed in fffffff`. MEMBER13 retains its recorded `fix: retain delay`; NEW13 → `still open`. MEMBER14 → newly resolved. Do not infer member fixes from home’s first-parent history.
- **Strip/seal:** remove only ephemeral plans; preserve spec and telemetry. Seal with `--option pr --base origin/main --spec SPEC`. Any seal failure would stop landing. Retain successful seal stdout for verbatim completion reporting.
- **Preserve:** create `refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-12` → A, `/pr-13` → B, `/pr-14` → C; stop on any failure.
- **Push:** only `HEAD:refs/heads/retry`, non-force, with `--no-follow-tags`. Save P. Preserve the worktree.

### Fresh description append

Decode the freshly fetched body without trimming. An outside-repository scratch file starts with exactly `Original description\n`, then one blank line, then:

```markdown
## Rework

Before: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa (local ref `refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-12` in the rework checkout; the SHA is the portable handle and stays on origin because the push was not forced)
Absorbs: #13 (https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/13), #14 (https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/14)
Spec: SPEC at P7
Keeps: retry behavior
Changes: repair retries
Dropped claims: none
Verification: scoped - test-retry; CI on this push holds the full run. Telemetry: whole PR against main.
Threads:
#12:
- src/retry.ts:1 - fixed in fffffff
#13:
- src/delay.ts:2 - fix: retain delay (recorded; unchanged)
- NEW13 - still open
#14:
- src/cap.ts:3 - newly resolved
```

NEW13’s refreshed location must replace its identifier in the actual body; none was supplied here. No lowercase provenance enters combined fields.

Body write succeeds using:

```bash
gh pr edit 12 --repo acme/widget --body-file "$SCRATCH"
```

### Eligibility and exact close question

Refresh both members; both are OPEN, their current heads are available locally and ancestors of P.

```text
Close the absorbed PRs with these comments?
#13: "Reworked into #12 (https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/12) by the gauntlet; this PR's commits are merged there and remain reachable as bbbbbbb."
#14: "Reworked into #12 (https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/12) by the gauntlet; this PR's commits are merged there and remain reachable as ccccccc."
1 - yes, close #13, #14
2 - no, leave them open
```

**Answer 1:** immediate state/head rechecks are unchanged; close each once, with its displayed comment, without deleting branches. Then mark ship complete. **Closed: #13, #14.** Include seal stdout verbatim in completion.

### Independent deltas

- **Answer 2:** no closes; then complete ship. **Member PRs #13, #14 left open.**
- **#14 head changes after approval:** close #13; skip #14 under stale authorization. Then complete ship. **Closed: #13; #14 left open—head changed.**
- **#14 already CLOSED before eligibility:** report `#14 skipped: state CLOSED`; offer only #13. After approved successful close, complete ship. **Closed: #13; #14 already CLOSED.**
- **#14 close fails:** report once, never retry; then complete ship. **Closed: #13; #14 close failed (<error>), left open.**
- **Choose row 5:** Keep, not Discard. No strip, seal, push, body edit, or closure. **Keeping branch retry. Worktree preserved at /work/widget/.worktrees/retry. Member PRs #13, #14 left open.** Complete ship after Keep succeeds.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: No fact moved between the two outputs: both prove A/B/C as ancestors before the push, write refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-12/13/14, push only home non-force after evidence capture and strip/seal, succeed the body edit before the exact two-target close question, keep #12/#13/#14 thread attribution with HOME proven by the accepted-complete first-parent commit fffffff and member dispositions copied without home-history inference, and name every variant outcome including ship-completion timing and both untouched members under row 5. The After wording is slightly tighter in places that help the facts stay robust (per-target recheck immediately before each close, explicit `(exit 0)` ancestry proof, `Spec: <spec> at S` tied to the pushed post-seal head, and a table that keeps each variant's report string on one line); keep those. Two small things to watch so the facts don't regress on other inputs: the After stale-#14 report string drops the explicit `(left open)` that Before carried, so consider `Closed: #13; #14 skipped: head moved to <sha7> after approval (not in home, left open)` to keep the open state unambiguous, and the After already-CLOSED variant folds `#14 skipped: state CLOSED` into the final report rather than printing it at eligibility time — printing it before the single-target question (as Before does) makes the exclusion visibly precede the question.
